# Exemplar

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Exemplar`](gmeow-Exemplar.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Exemplar>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A citation act that holds something up as an example — positively, negatively, or as a cautionary boundary case. Pins into the cited work via the citation [`Selector`](gmeow-Selector.md) machinery (page, quote, locator) AND/OR names an entity subject ([`gmeow:exemplarSubject`](../properties/gmeow-exemplarSubject.md) — a character's conduct across a whole work, EPIC coordination): at least one of the two (SHACL). The kernel aboutness axis carries the phase-gate: an exemplar whose span DESCRIBES trust is source material; one whose span ENACTS it is embodiment — same selector, different [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](../properties/gmeow-hasAboutness.md), different anchored range. CiTO alignment arrives free through [`CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Exemplar`](gmeow-Exemplar.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
